surface_request: Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
plan:
SOURCE: Untrusted `filename` string from the caller.
TRUST: `reports_root` is the approved filesystem root; every path component derived from `filename` is untrusted.
SINK: Open and read the resolved target as a UTF-8 text file located beneath `reports_root`.
GUARD: Reject the request if any user-selected path component is a symbolic link, even when that link currently points to a file inside the approved root; reject if the resolved realpath escapes `reports_root`; treat both as disallowed.
ORDER: Resolve the candidate path relative to `reports_root`; inspect each user-selected component for symlink status before opening; verify the fully resolved path remains inside `reports_root`; then perform the read.
EFFECT: Return the file content as `str`; propagate `FileNotFoundError` for a missing ordinary file; raise `ValueError` when the request is disallowed.
END_PLAN
